description: Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education - The universities Act, No. 16 of 1978 (Amendment) Order Under section.27(1) read with Section 22 - Sri Palee Campus of the University of Colombo.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of university faculties and departments through a legal order under the Universities Act. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and modifications to existing legal frameworks, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Harini Amarasuriya, the focus is on the legal authority and regulatory changes rather than her appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
